title: Jordan Medical Council recognised specialties (الإختصاصات الطبية)
notes: All 55 entries on jmc.gov.jo/medical-specialties (3 listing pages) plus their detail pages (1 req/s; robots.txt allows these paths). Includes dental specialties (e.g. Orthodontics, Endodontics, Prosthodontics) mixed in with medical ones - the source does not label them. Extra records: 3 haematology/oncology tracks, 6 laboratory-medicine tracks and 4 community-medicine branches listed inside their pages. parent is filled ONLY where the page states an entry requirement of a JMC certificate in one specialty (e.g. Gastroenterology <- Internal Medicine) or for the in-page tracks; specialties with alternative entry paths (Cardiology, Neurology, Cardiac Surgery, adult ICU) have parent null and the raw requirement text in extra.requirements_ar. name_en is the JMC's own English (typos kept, e.g. 'Recanstractive', 'Veneriology'). Three entries have empty detail pages (الأشعة العلاجية, الأمراض الإنتانية, الأمراض الرئوية) and may duplicate Radiation oncology / Infectious Diseases / Pulmonary Diseases - kept, not merged. The JMC page lists Jordanian Board programmes; it is not stated to be the complete legal list of recognised specialties under the JMC law.
